_about: The single machine-readable inference-surface registry mandated by HELLOLILLY_ARCH_RULES.md Section 5 (D12, 2026-07-11). One file, not scattered flags. Membership is declared here at design time; each surface's `path` is filled when the tool is built.
definition: An inference surface is any path that writes an interpretation of the person's state (confidence, wellbeing, barriers, motivation) to a stored shape, or renders one to a coach-facing view.
inclusionTest: IN if the path writes an interpretation of the person's state to a stored shape OR renders one to a coach-facing view. OUT if it is conversational padding that stores nothing and reaches no coach. When in doubt, it is in.
realPersonsGate: REFUSAL. No non-demo use by any real jobseeker other than Daniel of any surface below until the governance review (AI Act, coach-facing surfaces, data controls) is recorded done AND docs/RETROFIT_LEDGER.md is empty. Demo use continues freely.
sensitiveClass: Participation is sensitive by inference (unemployment status); barrier data touches disability, language origin, neurodivergence. Bound now: synthetic-only eval fixtures and no person-data in logs beyond what the store holds.

surfaces.name: Transition View coach prompts
surfaces.interpretationOf: state summarized for a coach (confidence, wellbeing, barriers, motivation)

surfaces.name: Outcome Engine per-group analyses
surfaces.interpretationOf: barriers, motivation, wellbeing across a group
